notes: The requested exact lifecycle firing points are not specified by the issue or established in the repository. Vanilla has no NeoForge lifecycle events: MinecraftServer.runServer calls initServer and later stopServer in a finally block, including failure paths. The public ServerStartingEvent documentation only places it between about-to-start and started, and ServerStoppedEvent does not settle Horizon's startup-failure, crash, and failed-save behavior. The existing server_started is already at the successful initialization/tick-loop boundary, while Horizon's integrated and dedicated startup and teardown paths differ. Choosing sites and failure semantics would therefore guess at the counterpart contract. No code or PR was created; an authoritative 26.3 firing-point and failure-semantics specification would unblock the work.
